subject: sociology

moments.title: Risk Society
moments.body: Beck's book is published shortly after Chernobyl. Modern society, he argues, produces manufactured risks that overflow national and class boundaries.

moments.title: English translation
moments.body: Beck's book reaches anglophone sociology, shaping debates about globalisation and the environment.
moments.takeaway: Translation timing again reshapes a thinker's audience.

moments.title: Individualization
moments.body: Beck and Beck-Gernsheim analyse how individualisation reorganises family, biography and work.
moments.takeaway: Risk society implies new biographical structures.

now.title: Risk in global perspective
now.body: Pandemics, climate change and AI risks are analysed through Beck's framework, alongside critiques of its Eurocentric assumptions.
now.open_questions: How does Beck's framework apply to societies experiencing climate risk before late modernity?

reflection: Beck's book transformed environmental sociology and modern political theory.
